items.t: Quarterly Profit Could Change The Case For Evofem Biosciences Stock
items.sum: Evofem Biosciences reported third quarter 2026 net income of US$1 million, shifting from a net loss of US$1.57 million in the same period a year earlier, with basic earnings per share from continuing operations at US$0.01.
